question: Approve 080 (Annual category drilldown: monthly totals + category trend chart, then expenses per month) to move into spec?

artifacts.summary: Today clicking a category on Annual lists every expense of the year. Seed: show one total per month for that category, a monthly trend chart for that category only, and click a month to see its individual expenses. Excludes the Monthly tab drilldown and category membership. Spec decides layout, toggle interaction, and how month rows open.
